about: A newer build's pet: a species this build does not know (it reads OTHER) and a new key.

notPreserved.microchip: this build writes the document back with set(), which replaces it: a top-level key it does not know is dropped. A newer build must not keep anything it cannot afford to lose in a new top-level key of a collection older builds rewrite
notPreserved.species: an unknown species reads as OTHER (PetSpecies.fromStored) and is written back as OTHER: an older build's edit of the pet erases the newer species
